tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground (warm ivory / deep night). A named ground per palette, never a default near-white.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on background, card, popover and muted. 13.9–17.2:1 across palettes.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Standard and Dunia card surface. Pure white in light palettes.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card. Alias of foreground.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Dialogs, dropdown menus, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover. Alias of foreground.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Deep emerald (Ikhwan) / deep plum (Akhwat). Primary button, active nav tab, links, selected day, focus ring source. As text on card: 7.2:1 minimum.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on primary fills. 7.5–9.1:1.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Soft sage / soft rose. The Rencana hari ini date panel, secondary button, planner tiles.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary. 11:1 minimum.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: status chips (pending AND skipped share it), skeletons, hover tint on ghost and outline.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text (subtitles, meta, timestamps) on background, card and muted. 5.2:1 minimum.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fresh lime / soft rose. Dikerjakan pill, today circle in the week strip. A fill only, never text on a light ground.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on accent fills. 8.3:1 minimum.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline 1px for cards, list dividers, separators. Decorative: never the only cue that something is a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Control border: inputs, textareas, outline buttons, the Lewati pill on light grounds. 3.2:1 minimum on card and background.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus-visible ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. 7.2:1 minimum on every ground.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Real validation failures and irreversible deletes only. Never for skipped or missed tasks.

tokens.name: card-inverse
tokens.usage: The dark well reserved for the Akhirat task card, and nothing else. In dark palettes it sits BELOW background so it still reads as a well.

tokens.name: card-inverse-foreground
tokens.usage: Headline and pill labels on card-inverse. 12.8:1 minimum.

tokens.name: card-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Summary line, time meta, AKHIRAT eyebrow and Lewati pill on card-inverse. 7.7:1 minimum.

tokens.name: card-inverse-border
tokens.usage: The Akhirat card edge. Equal to the card in light palettes (invisible); a faint hairline in dark ones where the well sits near the ground.

tokens.name: reward
tokens.usage: Warm amber / champagne gold. ONLY the hadith-source fragment on card-inverse, e.g. (HR. Tirmidzi no. 241). 6.2:1 minimum. Never decorative.

tokens.name: reward-ink
tokens.usage: The same sacred role on light grounds: the citation line in the dalil dialog. Darker amber in light palettes (5.6:1), equal to reward in dark.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Beranda greeting and page titles (Profil, Journal). clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 1.875rem) in code.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Date numerals in the date panel, dialog titles.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings: Rencana hari ini, Aktivitasku, Journal harian.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Task card headline. Sans, not serif: it is an action, not a moment.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and template titles, list row titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Badan bugar, mood naik — energi buat ibadah pun ikut penuh.
styles.usage: All functional copy: summaries, translations, form values.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Mengingat-ingat anugerah Allah membuahkan kecintaan kepada Allah

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, pill and small button labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase category chips (AKHIRAT / DUNIA). Always uppercase, always tracked.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, week-strip day names, hijri sub-numerals. tabular-nums for times.

styles.name: arabic-lg
styles.usage: Dua card and dalil dialog Arabic. dir="rtl" lang="ar". Read aloud, so 2.0 leading.

styles.name: arabic-md
styles.usage: Inline Arabic in lists and compact cards. Never below 20px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between paired pills (Dikerjakan / Lewati), icon + text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards inside a panel; list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter; standard card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Task card and date panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of page to greeting; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Bottom clearance above the bottom nav.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon chips, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Dropdown items, tab triggers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Base (--radius). Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Standard cards, dua card, template cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Akhirat and Dunia task cards.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Date panel, dialog and sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-4xl
tokens.usage: Phone-frame mocks only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dikerjakan / Lewati pills, week-strip day circles, avatar.

shadow.note: Flat unless floating. Cards, rows and chips never take a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The quick-add + button only.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Dialog and bottom-sheet surface over the scrim.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover tint, pill press, tab change. ease-out.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Dialog fade + 8px slide, card swap after Dikerjakan / Lewati. ease-out. 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.
